description: Prompts an agent with the kirora-cli skill should turn into the commands described. Check every expected command against `kirora commands` when the CLI changes.

evals.prompt: Add or update the contact cust_1042 with the email ada@example.com in Kirora.
Give me the email address of every contact in the VIP segment, seg_9.
expectations: Reads one JSON item per line (for example with `jq -r .email`), not a `data` array

evals.prompt: Send the transactional email in message.json for order 1001, and make sure a retry can't send it twice.
expectations: Passes an `--idempotency-key` tied to the order, such as `order-1001`, and reuses it on a retry
Adds `--yes`, since the user asked for the deletion and no one is at a terminal

evals.prompt: Tag segment seg_1 as vip, but show me the request before you send it.
expectations: Runs `kirora segments update seg_1 --tags vip --dry-run` first
Puts the id before `--tags`, so the list flag doesn't take it
Sends without `--dry-run` only after the user agrees

evals.prompt: Unsubscribe the contact with the email ada@example.com from the topic top_news.
expectations: Uses `kirora contacts topics set`, with the contact and `top_news` as arguments or as `--contact-id` and `--topic-id`
Passes `--id-type email` so the email address is read as the contact's id
Sends the choice itself in `--data`, as the body has no flag for it

evals.prompt: I'm building a webhook handler on localhost:3000/webhooks. Let me see Kirora's delivery events hit it; my ngrok URL is https://abc.ngrok.app.
expectations: May narrow with `--events message.delivered`; doesn't create a permanent webhook with `webhooks create`

evals.prompt: Kirora commands keep failing for me with an auth error. What's wrong?
expectations: Runs `kirora doctor` or `kirora whoami` before guessing
Never asks for the API key to be pasted into a command, and never prints one
